name: Leveraged-ETF close rebalance: follow today's move from 15:45
why: Daily-reset leveraged and inverse ETFs must buy into the close after an up day and sell after a down day, in proportion to today's return from the prior close; the flow is forced and price-insensitive. Pre-registered 2026-10-23 (research/preregistered/2026-10-23_starnet_open_items.md X1).
